# Software & AI Engineering Concepts

> A directory of software systems, LLM application engineering, and technical leadership concepts.

Author and maintainer: Saad Ahmed (https://github.com/iamsaad640).
This release lists concept names and reference links. Use the topic pages to locate terminology; they are not full tutorials.

## Directory

- [All topics](https://concepts.saad.run/docs/README.md)
- [Alphabetical index](https://concepts.saad.run/docs/glossary.md)
